title: Daniel Jones says he's fully cleared for Colts training camp, less than 8 months since tearing his Achilles tendon

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Daniel Jones says he's fully cleared for Colts training camp, less than 8 months since tearing his Achilles tendon
sources.description: For Jones to deliver on his contract, he'll need to do more than return healthy. He'll need prove that his early-season success in 2025 that belied his six previous seasons of NFL football wasn't a fluke.
